title: Check for updates
checking: Looking for a newer version of Scriptorum…
noAddress: No update address is set yet, so Scriptorum cannot look for a newer version. Nothing was sent anywhere.
notHttps: The update address is not a secure https address, so Scriptorum did not use it.
noDownload: The update file gives no download page for this computer.
current: Scriptorum is up to date. You have the newest version, {current}.
unreachable: The update address could not be reached. Nothing else is affected; you can try again later.
invalid: The update file could not be read. Nothing else is affected.
askText: Should Scriptorum look for a newer version once a week? It reads one small file from the project's web address and sends nothing about you or your adventures. You can change this at any time in Settings ▸ Application.
ready: Ready. The update is installed the next time Scriptorum starts.
installUnreachable: The update could not be downloaded. Nothing has changed; you can try again later.
installRefused: The update was refused because it is damaged or not signed with the project's key. Nothing has changed.
needsInstaller: This version needs a new installer, so it can only be installed from the download page.
unsigned: The update file is not signed with the project's key, so Scriptorum ignored it. Nothing else is affected.
noKey: This copy of Scriptorum holds no update key yet, so it cannot trust any update file. Nothing else is affected.
addressRefused: Only a secure https address can be used, such as https://example.org/scriptorium-update.json. Nothing was changed.
moved: The update address has moved to {address}. Use the new address?
wentBack: Scriptorum {version} did not start, so Scriptorum went back to version {back}.
backDone: Scriptorum went back to version {version}, as you asked.
goBackAsk: Go back to Scriptorum {version} the next time Scriptorum starts? Your adventures, modules and settings are not changed.
goBackReady: Scriptorum {version} runs the next time Scriptorum starts.
